description.p: A desktop app for indie writers that turns a manuscript into a print-ready PDF and store-ready EPUBs. No subscription, no paywall, no AI. Your words stay on your computer.

ul.li: Write in chapters with typewriter, dim and focus modes
Design the pages with themes, trims, fonts and ornaments
Import Word, OpenDocument, Markdown and plain text manuscripts
Export print PDFs, large print and EPUBs for every store
